analysis:
This PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md; there is no code, config, or wire-format change in the supplied evidence. The supplied units are base_text only (lines 1629-2248), and the changed ranges (head 1494-1509 and 1556-1589) fall outside them. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the new "Streamed auto tool calls" section is not fully visible.

What the visible patch adds:
- A Qwen3-VL (`qwen3_vl_moe`) reasoning seed: an empty closed think block is prefixed when the prompt tail carries no think marker. It applies only on the qwen3 parser, is limited to `ReasoningPromptProbe.plainTailContentModelTypes`, and can be disabled with `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_THINK_CONTENT_SEED=0`.
- A new section describing streamed auto tool-call deltas (`streamToolCallDeltas`).

The visible text describes behavior over response output parsing. It does not touch encryption, attestation, the authorization boundary (TB-002, TB-011), prefix-cache storage (T-041), or key custody. I cannot tell whether the described code matches reality, and the described behavior is not claimed to weaken fail-closed encryption (T-008) or the stream router.

In the base text I saw nothing that conflicts with the threat model. The prefix-cache and SSD references are consistent with T-041: encrypted, scope-salted, and with no new at-rest claims.

The remaining uncertainties are the truncated streamed-tool-call section and the unseen implementation behind the doc claims. Neither is evidence of a regression, so I report no findings.
